dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Stormterror? One moment, let me try to recall the Knights of Favonius Handbook...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I don't remember anything in there that tells us what to do when facing giant dragons.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Oh, but I do remember that it does mention how to deal with sudden threats:

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: "When danger is imminent, please do not panic. Cover your head with both hands, and crouch down to protect your vital parts."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I think I'll do as this says...
